description: This file provides functions and constants for interacting with OpenAI's Text-to-Speech (TTS) API, including URL normalization, model and voice validation, error handling, and the main function to perform TTS requests.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAITtsBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes the base URL for OpenAI TTS API, trimming trailing slashes or returning default if input is undefined.

methods.name: isCustomOpenAIEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the provided URL is a custom endpoint different from the default OpenAI URL.

methods.name: isValidOpenAIModel
methods.description: Validates if a given model name is supported or if a custom endpoint is used.

methods.name: isValidOpenAIVoice
methods.description: Validates if a given voice name is supported or if a custom endpoint is used.

methods.name: resolveOpenAITtsInstructions
methods.description: Resolves instructions for specific models, particularly 'gpt-4o-mini-tts'.

methods.name: formatOpenAiErrorPayload
methods.description: Formats error payloads from OpenAI API responses into readable strings.

methods.name: extractOpenAiErrorDetail
methods.description: Extracts detailed error information from an API response.

methods.name: openaiTTS
methods.description: Main function to perform Text-to-Speech conversion via OpenAI API, handling request setup, validation, and error processing.
